Novomoskovsk Old Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Dnipropetrovs'ka oblast, Ukraine

Demolished. This cemetery served the Jewish community of Novomoskovsk, in Dnipropetrovsk Oblast, and was demolished around 1945, with the land distributed to local residents for construction. Two inscribed tombstones have since been recovered — one found by a local woman in her own yard in 2016, another found by a family in August 2020 and taken to the local museum by the ESJF, which also holds a fragment of a 1943 American map clearly showing the cemetery's original perimeter. A local resident named Tasya, born in 1938, showed surveyors where a high entrance arch once stood, now the site of a specific residential address.
